caseNameFull: Dantzler, President, South Carolina Naturopathic Physicians Association v. Callison, Attorney General
attorneys: Frederick Bernays Wiener, James H. Price and J. D. Poag for appellants. T. C. Callison, Attorney General of South Carolina, and James S. Verner and William A. Dallis, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
